description: Generate an image for a post from a text prompt and return its hosted URL, ready to pass to create_post as mediaUrl. Pass a brandingId from list_brandings to match the workspace's visual style. Spends AI tokens.

brandingId.description: Brand kit id from list_brandings, whose reference image steers the visual style.

prompt.description: What the image should show. Be specific about subject, composition, and mood.

styleImageUrl.description: Public URL of a reference image to steer style directly, instead of a brand kit.

workspaceId.description: Workspace (project) id to act on, from list_workspaces. Omit to use the caller's default workspace. Always pass this when the user belongs to more than one workspace.

name: generate_image
